title: Versioned evaluation profile
$comment: A profile is a complete standalone declaration that narrows the base under PROFILE-001. Set values use closed-enum order and keyed collections use lexical key order.

baseCompatibility.$comment: Binds the standard version, verdict, and requirement-registry identity, version, and digest. A document-relative URI may differ only when it resolves to that same artifact.

supportedAssuranceLevels.$comment: A complete declaration that is a nonempty subset of the base levels.

effectiveRiskRange.$comment: A complete declaration that is a nonempty subset of the base risk tiers. This range is only a profile eligibility boundary. The actual case, experiment, and decision tiers come from authenticated risk-assessment-1 records and are not inferred from this range.

capabilityFamilies.$comment: A complete declaration that is a nonempty subset of the base capability families.

interactionModes.$comment: A complete declaration of closed concrete IDs that is a nonempty subset of the base interaction modes.

workArtifactRegistry.$comment: The sole authenticated work-artifact-type to capability-family mapping. Resolves to one authenticated artifact; a document-relative URI may differ only when it resolves to that exact artifact.

allowedOutcomeProfiles.$comment: A complete declaration that resolves to a nonempty subset of the base outcome profiles; new outcome contracts are forbidden.

caseContract.$comment: The versioned profile-specific case-shape contract. Resolves to one authenticated artifact; a document-relative URI may differ only when it resolves to that exact artifact.

gateRegistry.$comment: Must preserve or strengthen every applicable base gate.

caseQa.$comment: Must preserve or strengthen every applicable base QA obligation.

metrics.$comment: A complete declaration keyed by id.

failureTaxonomy.$comment: Must not weaken or lose any applicable base cause, attribution, or fail-closed outcome.

additionalAssuranceRequirements.$comment: The base standard owns A1-A3 semantics. These entries are additive only; semantic validation must union them with the base level and all lower levels and must reject deletion, replacement, downgrade, or reinterpretation of a base assurance requirement.

fixtures.$comment: Semantic validation must authenticate an evaluator-pinned manifest and evaluator-pinned executor, resolve manifestExpectationId exactly once, execute that expectation under its declared schema and semantic checks, and require the observed result to match both manifest valid and expectedVerdict. A negative must fail for manifest expectedError. Descriptor-supplied validators or reports and execution cycles are invalid.
